SELECT province_id as "provinceId", city_id as "cityId", county_id as "countyId", street_id as "streetId",
province_name as "regionName", province_id as "areaCode",
concat(province_name, city_name) as "regionName", city_id as "areaCode",
concat(province_name, city_name, county_name) as "regionName", county_id as "areaCode",
concat(province_name, city_name, county_name, street_name) as "regionName", street_id as "areaCode",
region_name as "regionName",
IFNULL(sum( warning_num ),0) as num FROM vm_statistics_event_area dataTable where dataTable.county_id is not null ${dataScope}
AND `year` = YEAR(CURDATE())
AND `year` = YEAR(CURDATE()) AND `month` = MONTH(CURDATE())
AND DATE_FORMAT(create_date,'%Y-%m-%d') = DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(),interval 1 DAY) ,'%Y-%m-%d')
AND `year` = YEAR(CURDATE()) AND `month` = MONTH(CURDATE()) AND `day` = DAY(CURDATE())
AND create_date >= #{queryStartTime} AND create_date <= #{queryEndTime}
AND province_id = #{provinceId}
AND city_id = #{cityId}
AND (dataTable.county_id = #{countyId} or dataTable.province_id = #{countyId} or dataTable.city_id = #{countyId})
GROUP BY
province_id
city_id
county_id
street_id
GROUP BY province_id, city_id, county_id, street_id
order by num desc

SELECT dataTable.warning_type_id "typeId",SUM(dataTable.warning_num) num, SUM(dataTable.ai_num) "aiNum", SUM(dataTable.judge_num) "judgeNum", SUM(dataTable.real_num) "realNum", SUM(dataTable.false_num) "falseNum" FROM vm_statistics_event_type dataTable
AND DATE_FORMAT(dataTable.create_date ,'%Y') = DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE() ,'%Y')
AND DATE_FORMAT(dataTable.create_date ,'%Y-%m') = DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE() ,'%Y-%m')
AND DATE_FORMAT(dataTable.create_date,'%Y-%m-%d') = DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(),interval 1 DAY) ,'%Y-%m-%d')
AND DATE_FORMAT(dataTable.create_date,'%Y-%m-%d') = DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE() ,'%Y-%m-%d')
AND dataTable.create_date >= #{queryStartTime} AND dataTable.create_date <= #{queryEndTime}
AND LEFT(dataTable.county_id,2) = LEFT(#{provinceId},2)
AND LEFT(dataTable.county_id,4) = LEFT(#{cityId},4)
AND (dataTable.county_id = #{countyId} or dataTable.province_id = #{countyId} or dataTable.city_id = #{countyId})
${dataScope}
GROUP BY dataTable.warning_type_id ORDER BY num DESC,"typeId" DESC
SELECT type_value as "typeId",type_name as "typeName" FROM sys_alarm_type
SELECT industry_name as "industryName" FROM sys_industry_conf where industry_code = #{industryCode}

SELECT t1.label,IFNULL(t2.num,0) AS num FROM ( SELECT 0 AS `hour`,'0:00-1:00' AS label UNION SELECT 1 AS `hour`,'1:00-2:00' AS label UNION SELECT 2 AS `hour`,'2:00-3:00' AS label UNION SELECT 3 AS `hour`,'3:00-4:00' AS label UNION SELECT 4 AS `hour`,'4:00-5:00' AS label UNION SELECT 5 AS `hour`,'5:00-6:00' AS label UNION SELECT 6 AS `hour`,'6:00-7:00' AS label UNION SELECT 7 AS `hour`,'7:00-8:00' AS label UNION SELECT 8 AS `hour`,'8:00-9:00' AS label UNION SELECT 9 AS `hour`,'9:00-10:00' AS label UNION SELECT 10 AS `hour`,'10:00-11:00' AS label UNION SELECT 11 AS `hour`,'11:00-12:00' AS label UNION SELECT 12 AS `hour`,'12:00-13:00' AS label UNION SELECT 13 AS `hour`,'13:00-14:00' AS label UNION SELECT 14 AS `hour`,'14:00-15:00' AS label UNION SELECT 15 AS `hour`,'15:00-16:00' AS label UNION SELECT 16 AS `hour`,'16:00-17:00' AS label UNION SELECT 17 AS `hour`,'17:00-18:00' AS label UNION SELECT 18 AS `hour`,'18:00-19:00' AS label UNION SELECT 19 AS `hour`,'19:00-20:00' AS label UNION SELECT 20 AS `hour`,'20:00-21:00' AS label UNION SELECT 21 AS `hour`,'21:00-22:00' AS label UNION SELECT 22 AS `hour`,'22:00-23:00' AS label UNION SELECT 23 AS `hour`,'23:00-24:00' AS label) t1 LEFT JOIN (SELECT warning_hour, SUM(warning_num) AS num FROM vm_statistics_event_hour dataTable
AND `year` = YEAR(CURDATE())
AND `year` = YEAR(CURDATE()) AND `month` = MONTH(CURDATE())
AND DATE_FORMAT(create_date,'%Y-%m-%d') = DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(),interval 1 DAY) ,'%Y-%m-%d')
AND `year` = YEAR(CURDATE()) AND `month` = MONTH(CURDATE()) AND `day` = DAY(CURDATE())
AND create_date >= #{queryStartTime} AND create_date <= #{queryEndTime}
AND LEFT(dataTable.county_id,2) = LEFT(#{provinceId},2)
AND LEFT(dataTable.county_id,4) = LEFT(#{cityId},4)
AND (dataTable.county_id = #{countyId} or dataTable.province_id = #{countyId} or dataTable.city_id = #{countyId})
${dataScope}
GROUP BY warning_hour ORDER BY warning_hour) t2 ON t1.`hour` = t2.warning_hour ORDER BY t1.`hour`
select AREA_NAME from sys_area where DEL_FLAG = '0' AND AREA_CODE = #{areaCode}
select AREA_LEVEL from sys_area where DEL_FLAG = '0' AND AREA_CODE = #{areaCode}
